acceptance_criteria.statement: Machine-readable autonomous external-precondition recovery and repair verification has executable implementation and behavior-specific automated verification.
Resilience state remains source-grounded, traceable, evidence-backed, and repository-valid.

definition_of_done: Implementation is present and behaviorally verified.
Relevant requirements, tests, plans, ADRs, upstream decisions, and evidence are linked.
External dependencies remain bounded adapters until live-qualified.
Recovery behavior fails closed where authority is uncertain.
description: Implement machine-readable autonomous external-precondition recovery and repair verification. The implementation is deterministic, locally verified, and preserves ProjectPipeline authority without assigning routine work outside the autonomy runtime.
exclusions: No live external runtime or backup/restore claim without executed environment evidence.
objective: Implement machine-readable autonomous external-precondition recovery and repair verification
observability_impact: Recovery decisions, operating modes, objectives, simulations, and verification outcomes are structured and evidence-linked.
rationale: Implements the source-grounded resilience/recovery capability through bounded deterministic components and explicit operational evidence.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve prior durable state/evidence; fail closed, roll back code/schema/IaC plans, and never rewrite historical recovery evidence.
security_impact: Preserves deterministic authority, fenced failover, scoped credentials, local/private model boundaries, and explicit external-mutation gates.
title: Implement autonomous external-precondition recovery and repair verification
